_note: Secret Vault water way back timings. Times in seconds; distances in 1920x1080 pixels.

water._note: rise_s: the fade-out, the water rising over the screen; drain_s: the fade-in, the water draining down (its first moments out of sight); the drain's sound plays surface_sound_at_s into the fade-in. Wave height (px), froth and churn (how fast the pattern inside moves) go from their calm value at rest to their swell value at the water's fastest; the pattern moves carry of the surface's way, so the water flows as it moves.

bubbles._note: bubbles spawn at about spawn_rising / spawn_covered / spawn_draining per second while the water rises, covers the screen and drains; each rises at speed_min to speed_max px per second and wobbles wobble_min to wobble_max px at wobble_hz_min to wobble_hz_max times per second
